title: logger_utils¶
content:
logger_utils¶

Utilities to create and set the logger.

Manim’s logger can be accessed asmanim.logger, or aslogging.getLogger("manim"), once the library has been imported.  Manim also
exports a second object,console, which should be used to print on screen
messages that need not be logged.

Bothloggerandconsoleuse therichlibrary to produce rich text
format.

Classes

JSONFormatter

A formatter that outputs logs in a custom JSON format.
